name: Lanternwing Roundup
description: An original first-person 3D sanctuary contains wandering paper-and-light creatures whose capture capsules follow a visible gravity-driven flight.
natural_language: Round up the three marked lanternwings in the terraced sanctuary. Choose a useful launch position, estimate range and height, lead each moving wing, and throw gravity-driven capsules.

metadata.notes: Gravity-driven projectile motion, target movement in three coordinates, terrain rendering, browser hit testing, server grading, and exported verification share one original contract. The source supplies the capture/flight mechanic only; no source assets or code are bundled.
